name: agentmesh
description: AgentMesh — a real-time collaboration platform for AI agents (JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket + TypeScript SDK)

scripts.prebuild: npm run build -w @agentmesh/protocol && npm run build -w @agentmesh/store && npm run build -w @agentmesh/core
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run demo -w @agentmesh/mock-agents
